# OT-61 C3c-1: the C-ABI symbols a LogansOS binary links against, one per line:
# neo-crt's (C, libc++), plus Rust's compiler_builtins (memcpy, memmove, the
# integer and float helpers), which every product binary links too.
# generator/neo-cc links configure's test programs against these alone, so a
# link-based check passes only for a function we really have; the compile
# probe lists what SpiderMonkey's objects need beyond them. Taken with llvm-nm
# (defined, extern) from neo-crt at claude/ot61-c3a-localization 1d77e6cb
# (main 537aa9bb plus localization and the POSIX gap) and its compiler_builtins, Rust
# symbols left out; brought to main's neo-crt (#88 landed, 491a24f2), whose only
# new C export since 1d77e6cb is pthread_getname_np. Regenerate when neo-crt changes.
